Tusks are there, but two of three must-reads are not: the muzzle is a smooth rounded dog-like snout with a dark nose blob and zero bristle moustache, and the body is a straight-sided furry loaf with vertical hair striations (no wrinkles, no blubber rolls) standing on four clawed three-toed paws rather than flippers — plus a large glossy cartoon eye where the row calls for small.

Colour is inverted and the silhouette is wrong: the body is pale grey/white with only the head and tail dark, instead of black fur with a white chest band; the head is small and rounded with a closed muzzle rather than an oversized blocky skull with gaping jaws, and the long slim legs raise the torso into a lamb/deer stance with a thin drooping tail rather than a low stocky body with a thick tapering tail.

Two must-reads are missing and one is wrong: the centre is a flat dull khaki-olive disc with no shading or dome relief (not a deep chocolate-brown raised dome), the rays are short blunt lemon-yellow cog teeth radiating flat and perfectly symmetric (not golden-orange or drooping), and there is no bristle anywhere — the leaves are clean-edged glossy lance blades ladder-paired opposite up a perfectly straight smooth stem, i.e. a generic fern-frond herb chassis rather than the alternate rough-hairy stem the row calls for.

Tall single upright stem with ~8 fern-like fronds of many tiny narrow leaflets instead of four oval leaflets in two pairs; no yellow flowers, no spreading habit, and the only tan pod sits at the top of the stem rather than underground.

Reads as a fern/mimosa frond — a rigid vertical stem with paired flat side-branches of discrete chevron tick-marks rather than a cloud of hair-fine threads; the yellow apex is one solid mushroom-cap blob with no spoke-like umbel rays, and the stem and foliage are bright yellow-olive with no blue-grey tint.

The render is a fan of thin grass-like blades splaying from a small base — not a sphere at all; there is no hollow green ball studded with identical surface cells, no daughter colonies inside, and no translucent jelly, so all three must-reads are absent and a stranger would call this a tuft of grass.
